_comment: Test matrix for the 'Preset Model Regression Test (8xH100)' workflow
These models are too large for auto-provisioned pools, so they run on the pre-provisioned
8xH100 nodes of a shared cluster in BYO mode: the workflow reserves two nodes with a label
and every Workspace selects them, so `instanceTypes` is intentionally empty here.
`nodes` is the expected output of the KAITO node estimator; the workflow reports a warning
(not a failure) when status.targetNodeCount differs, since the estimator picks the real count.
Set `skip: true` on a model to exclude it; `skipReason` is shown in the report.
